svg.title: A tight-binding band has wavevector-dependent curvature mass
svg.desc: For epsilon=2t_h[1-cos(ka)], the normalized energy is 1-cos(ka), group velocity divided by 2t_h a/hbar is sin(ka), and m_edge/m_curv=cos(ka), where m_edge=hbar squared/(2t_h a squared). A near-bottom parabola has normalized energy (ka) squared/2. Inverse curvature mass changes sign at plus or minus pi/2. No divergent mass pole is plotted.
